name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle on two or three wheels with a saddle or seat the rider sits astride; an electric two-wheeler past both the e-bike and limited speed motorcycle limits, such as a fast e-moto or a street-plated electric dirt bike, is one.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and a saddle or seat the rider sits astride
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 1

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed; one within the limited speed motorcycle limits is that class instead
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 1; Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 or 8 motorcycle licence; a Class 6L or 8L learner rides supervised, without passengers, not between sunset and sunrise, and no faster than 60 km/h until passing a skills test
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, ss. 30.01(2) and 30.06 to 30.08

restrictions.rule: A licence earned on a motor scooter covers only scooters and limited speed motorcycles
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act Regulations, B.C. Reg. 26/58, s. 30.12(1)

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear a motorcycle safety helmet; a passenger needs a seat designed for one and must keep both feet on the pegs or floorboards
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 194

restrictions.rule: Registered, licensed and insured with ICBC before it's used on a highway
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 3(1)

restrictions.rule: Ridden off the highway on Crown land, it's an off-road vehicle under the Off-Road Vehicle Act
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 1; Off-Road Vehicle Regulation, B.C. Reg. 193/2015, s. 2
